title: Trump announces 'Super Intelligence Force' to coordinate on AI
dek: A White House unit called the Super Intelligence Force will report directly to the president and work with companies and infrastructure operators.
body:
Donald Trump has created a group called the "Super Intelligence Force." He uses the term "superintelligence" to refer to artificial intelligence. The unit will report directly to the president and work with private-sector AI companies, operators of critical infrastructure, and interest groups.

## Why it matters

The White House has set up a direct line from an AI-focused unit to the president. That elevates AI coordination inside the federal government and links the administration to private companies and infrastructure operators. What the group will do in practice, how it will be structured, and what authority it will have have not been disclosed.

## The details

- The new unit is called the Super Intelligence Force. "Superintelligence" is the administration’s term for artificial intelligence (AI).
- It reports directly to the president.
- Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton is the leader; other government officials will also take part.
- The force will coordinate with AI companies, operators of critical infrastructure, and interest groups.
- Public reporting so far does not specify the force’s specific missions, legal authority, membership beyond Jay Clayton and unnamed officials, budget, or operating procedures.

## What to watch

Look for formal documents or statements that define the force’s mission, legal basis, and membership. Also watch for announcements about funding or directives that clarify whether the group will set policy, conduct oversight, or act as a liaison to industry.

Source: [The Decoder](https://the-decoder.com/trump-launches-super-intelligence-force-that-has-nothing-to-do-with-actual-superintelligence/)
